Shadows of Mindor'' |author=[[Matthew Stover]] ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' |cover artist=[[Dave Seeley]] |illustrator= |editor= |publisher=[[Del Rey]] |early release= |release date=[[December 30]], [[2008]]{{RandomHouseOld|url=author/results.pperl?authorid=82866|text=Matthew Stover}} |intl release= |rereleased= |media type=Hardcover |pages=311 |isbn=9780345477446 |isbn2= |isbn3= |timeline=[[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]] |series= |preceded by="[[Easy Credits]]" |followed by=''[[The Glove of Darth Vader]]'' }} {{Quote|None of the stories people tell about me can change who I really am.|Luke Skywalker|''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''}} '''''Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor''''' is a standalone novel by [[Matthew Stover]] that chronicles the [[Battle of Mindor]]. It was originally scheduled to be released in hardcover in [[February]] [[2008]] by [[Del Rey]], but was later moved to [[October 21]] before being eventually released on [[December 30]]. The paperback was released on [[February 23]], [[2010]].
